evaluation_protocol.area_definition: COCO default original-image bbox area ranges, IoU 0.50:0.95
notes: COCO area evaluation on converted VisDrone labels, not official VisDrone ignore regions.
Ultralytics AP and COCO AP_all are separate evaluators/prediction passes; do not mix them.
Batch val may use rectangular padding; area predict uses each 4-image chunk padding.
P/R are Ultralytics selected F1 operating point metrics, not P/R at conf=0.001.
Training built-in validation may use FP16 and double batch; final report is standalone FP32.

p2_architecture.variant: E9b = frozen E1 P2 baseline + PGALP at layer 26. Raw P3 guides a spatial foreground reliability map and per-location 3/5/7 Gaussian selection for fused P2.

pgalp.output: shape-preserving cleaned P2; P3/P4/P5 detection paths unchanged

tal2.note: Only matching chunk size changes from 1 to 2.

p2_architecture.fairness: All formal hyperparameters equal E1. Same original yolo11s.pt and deterministic E1 P2/Detect initialization; only PGALP parameters are new.
p2_architecture.claim_boundary: E9b tests PGALP independently on E1. It contains no DySample and no P3SDE.

preflight_transfer.rule: original layers 0..22 unchanged; Detect 23->27 and branches 0..2->1..3
preflight_transfer.source: original 80-class yolo11s.pt; never an experiment best.pt
preflight_transfer.initialization_note: All unchanged tensors use original yolo11s.pt. P2-C3k2 and the complete Detect initialization are copied tensor-for-tensor from deterministic E1. Only PGALP is new.

implementation.note: Only matching chunk size changes from 1 to 2.

matching_equivalence.limits: Synthetic FP32-GT cases and batch8 real-model 128px steps; not a 1024px memory test or a guarantee of identical final AP.

smoke_gate.note: Two full training epochs + builtin validation + full FP32/area evaluation. Not an accuracy result.

training.memory_note: PyTorch allocator peaks, including in-training validation; not whole-device usage.
training.comparison_note: Full forward batch unchanged; image-wise matching only. Training time/memory comparisons require the same matching implementation on both models.

pretrained_transfer.rule: original layers 0..22 unchanged; Detect 23->27 and branches 0..2->1..3
pretrained_transfer.source: original 80-class yolo11s.pt; never an experiment best.pt
pretrained_transfer.initialization_note: All unchanged tensors use original yolo11s.pt. P2-C3k2 and the complete Detect initialization are copied tensor-for-tensor from deterministic E1. Only PGALP is new.

validation.speed_note: Batched FP32 validation, NOT batch=1 deployment FPS.

model_profile.GFLOPs_note: GFLOPs is the legacy THOP value; GFLOPs_corrected adds the three functional depthwise Gaussian filters at P2 resolution.

pgalp_learned_state.note: Nonzero learned routing/scale values show use, but are not an accuracy metric.
